shortDescription: Enter dimensions or a volume, pick a material, and get the weight in grams before you open your slicer. PLA, PETG, ABS, resin, and more.

name: EU Import & Landed Cost Calculator
h1: EU 3D Printing Import & Landed Cost Calculator
metaTitle: EU 3D Printing Import & Landed Cost Calculator — €3 Customs Duty + VAT | STLACCESS
shortDescription: The true landed cost in EUR for 3D printing supplies shipped into the EU — item price, shipping, the €3 per-item customs duty, and import VAT for your country.
description: Sticker prices on foreign webshops no longer tell the whole story. Since 1 July 2026 the EU charges a €3 customs duty per item on parcels valued up to €150, and import VAT applies to the item price, shipping, and duty combined. Enter what you are buying, how many distinct product categories are in the box, and your country's VAT rate — the calculator gives you the full landed cost in EUR instantly. Built for EU makers ordering filaments, nozzles, heater blocks, and printer parts from outside the EU. Runs entirely in your browser — no uploads, no accounts, no cookies.
features: €3 flat customs duty per item category

shortDescription: Calculate exact dimensional scaling compensation for resin and FDM 3D printing. Prevent shrinkage distortion and ensure precise part-to-part fitting.
description: When 3D printing engineering components or tight-tolerance miniatures, material cooling and UV curing cause physical parts to shrink.
